usage: cbus-toolkit [-h] [--version] [--compact]
                    {edlt-templates,preferences,update-link,update-catalogue,update-metadata-stages,update-package-file,update-download,update-revocation-stages,update-condition-stages,update-condition-live,update-diagnostic-bundle,update-package-bundle,update-applicability-preflight,update-applicability-cohort-preflight,update-rollout-cohort,update-rollout-owned-registry,update-rollout-current-user,update-trust,update-composite-report,pci-route,toolkit-about,toolkit-database-csv,thermostat-temperature,thermostat-scheduling,thermostat,interface,project,cgate,serial-address,pci,simulator,inventory,unit-schema,coverage,memory,barcode,calculator,keys,sensors,din-settings,iope-settings,iope-workflow,dlt,wireless,edlt,unit-templates,firmware,unit-scenes,unit-conversion,scene,unit-addressing} ...

C-Bus commissioning CLI. Use coverage to inspect verified scope.

positional arguments:
  {edlt-templates,preferences,update-link,update-catalogue,update-metadata-stages,update-package-file,update-download,update-revocation-stages,update-condition-stages,update-condition-live,update-diagnostic-bundle,update-package-bundle,update-applicability-preflight,update-applicability-cohort-preflight,update-rollout-cohort,update-rollout-owned-registry,update-rollout-current-user,update-trust,update-composite-report,pci-route,toolkit-about,toolkit-database-csv,thermostat-temperature,thermostat-scheduling,thermostat,interface,project,cgate,serial-address,pci,simulator,inventory,unit-schema,coverage,memory,barcode,calculator,keys,sensors,din-settings,iope-settings,iope-workflow,dlt,wireless,edlt,unit-templates,firmware,unit-scenes,unit-conversion,scene,unit-addressing}
    edlt-templates      Inspect, export and preview local eDLT templates;
                        apply unavailable
    preferences         Inspect retained Toolkit settings and plan ordered
                        preference control edits
    update-link         Print the Toolkit download-page link without opening a
                        browser
    update-catalogue    Query unverified server-assigned candidates; does not
                        establish update availability
    update-metadata-stages
                        Evaluate offline metadata stages for a supplied
                        untrusted certificate; no publisher trust or update
                        availability claim
    update-package-file
                        Compare one local file with an untrusted SESU
                        catalogue descriptor; no download or install
    update-download     Download one catalogue-bound package file over
                        verified TLS; never installs or runs it
    update-revocation-stages
                        Evaluate offline revocation stages for a supplied
                        untrusted certificate; no publisher trust or update
                        availability claim
    update-condition-stages
                        Evaluate bounded original update conditions using
                        supplied facts; no live applicability query
    update-condition-live
                        Evaluate bounded update conditions with checked live
                        Windows HKCU observations
    update-diagnostic-bundle
                        Link exact catalogue, metadata, revocation and
                        condition report files without claiming update trust
                        or availability
    update-package-bundle
                        Reproduce update diagnostics and one local package
                        receipt against exact source files
    update-applicability-preflight
                        Inspect one untrusted catalogue node under an explicit
                        UTC/platform context; no publisher or install trust
    update-applicability-cohort-preflight
                        Inspect the empty-condition applicability path through
                        a caller-supplied rollout cohort; no host or trust
                        attestation
    update-rollout-cohort
                        Compare one untrusted catalogue visibility with a
                        supplied stored cohort; no registry or update trust
    update-rollout-owned-registry
                        Inspect an untrusted node through an explicitly owned
                        HKCU Registry32 cohort scratch key on Windows
    update-rollout-current-user
                        Read the pinned original SESU cohort in this Windows
                        process user's HKCU Registry32 view
    update-trust        Evaluate a supplied SESU signing chain and signed
                        revocation lists under explicit anchors; no fetch
    update-composite-report
                        Chain catalogue, metadata, revocation, conditions,
                        applicability, trust and download eligibility from one
                        supplied input set; never downloads
    pci-route           Encode or inspect CAL routing bytes offline
    toolkit-about       Read an explicit EXE and format Toolkit About
                        information offline
    toolkit-database-csv
                        Export captured Toolkit report values as CSV offline
    thermostat-temperature
                        Original thermostat scalar temperature conversions
    thermostat-scheduling
                        Evaluate retained outer scheduling selection over
                        supplied state
    thermostat          Thermostat Load Template and settings workflows
    interface           Discover CNI network interfaces and probe local serial
                        PCIs
    project             Edit legacy Toolkit XML/CBZ projects without
                        discarding unknown data
    cgate               Issue C-Gate commands using a persistent, correlated
                        connection
    serial-address      Inspect selected-serial bytes or plan, apply and
                        verify a guarded address move
    pci                 Direct CNI/PCI operations with source and parameter
                        correlation
    simulator           Persistent PCI fixture server with strict supported-
                        command handling
    inventory           Inspect the exact vendor's commands, unit catalog and
                        help
    unit-schema         Inspect and validate vendor unit parameters; does not
                        program hardware
    coverage            Show implementation and verification gaps
    memory              Encode/decode logical unit memory and masked patches;
                        no hardware I/O
    barcode             Interpret C-Bus barcode scanner text with Toolkit 1.18
                        rules
    calculator          Offline native-compatible network current and
                        impedance calculation
    keys                Inspect and plan classic key presets without hardware
                        I/O
    sensors             Plan the tested ST7 SENPILL, PIR and SENLL sensor
                        settings without C-Gate
    din-settings        Show or plan DIN relay/dimmer tab settings without
                        C-Gate
    iope-settings       Show or plan IOPE occupancy-controller settings
                        without C-Gate
    iope-workflow       Bounded IOPE Environment, output, join, timer, scene
                        selector and scene level workflows
    dlt                 Inspect DLT/eDLT profiles and edit classic DLT
                        controls and text
    wireless            Show or plan wireless gateway remotes and WRM globals
                        offline
    edlt                Plan tested eDLT widgets with configuration CRCs
                        offline
    unit-templates      Inspect Toolkit UnitTemplate XML or export a supported
                        PP snapshot
    firmware            eDLT diagnostics, offline firmware inspection and
                        explicitly selected USB DFU operations
    unit-scenes         Inspect or plan the tested KEYE1 stored scene table
                        offline
    unit-conversion     Plan classic programming alignment without C-Gate or
                        hardware I/O
    scene               Edit native C-Gate scene files
    unit-addressing     Compare database and scanned unit serial inventories
                        without making changes

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --compact             Emit single-line JSON
